landing.hero_title: Your social media, run like an agency would.
landing.hero_text: PostPilot builds your strategy, writes your copy, creates your visuals and prepares them for Facebook and Instagram. You keep the final say.
landing.mock_post_text: This Sunday, brunch is back on the terrace. Homemade bread, farm eggs, a view over the gulf: shall we save you a table?
landing.loop_title: From your brand to your results, without switching tools.
landing.loop_understand_text: Your website, the questionnaire and your posts become a brand DNA profile.
landing.loop_plan_text: Goals, pillars and a monthly calendar with local highlights.
landing.loop_create_text: Copy tailored to each network, visuals in your colors, carousels ready to publish.
landing.loop_publish_text: Approval first, then sent to your accounts, with no duplicates.
landing.loop_measure_text: Results explained in plain language, with concrete actions.
landing.loop_learn_text: What worked guides the following month.
landing.features_title: Content that sounds like you, not interchangeable copy.
landing.feature_dna_text: Tone, vocabulary, words to avoid, examples: everything is injected into every generation, and each correction you make enriches it.
landing.feature_knowledge_text: Your menu, prices and opening hours are retrieved at the moment of writing. Any figure missing from the base is flagged before approval.
landing.feature_local_text: Ramadan, Eid, back to school, sales, national holidays: your calendar follows the rhythm of Tunisia, in French, Arabic and dialect.
landing.guard_title: Automation never comes at the expense of trust.
landing.guard_2: No price or opening hours are ever made up
landing.guard_4: Every piece of content keeps a record of how it was generated
landing.plan_accounts: {count, plural, one {# social account} other {# social accounts}}
landing.faq_validation_q: Can anything go out without my approval?
landing.faq_validation_a: No. Human approval is the default, and automatic mode only turns on if you choose it, brand by brand.
landing.faq_invent_q: Can the AI make up a price?
landing.faq_invent_a: Prices, opening hours and addresses come from your knowledge base. Any figure that isn't in it is flagged before approval.
landing.faq_languages_q: Which languages can I post in?
landing.faq_languages_a: French, Arabic, English and Tunisian dialect, the latter in beta.
landing.faq_payment_a: The subscription is payable in dinars through a local payment gateway. No international card is needed.
landing.faq_networks_a: Facebook Pages and Instagram business accounts to start with. TikTok and LinkedIn will follow.

legal.privacy_intro: This page describes the data PostPilot processes, why, and how to exercise your rights, in accordance with Organic Law No. 2004-63 of 27 July 2004.
legal.privacy_p1: Your account (name, email address, language), information about your brand, the documents you upload, the content created and, if you connect a social network, the identifier and name of the pages concerned.
legal.privacy_p2: This data is used to provide the service: writing and preparing your content, publishing it to the accounts you have connected, and measuring your plan's quotas.
legal.privacy_p3: Access tokens are encrypted at rest, never sent to the browser, and deleted as soon as the account is disconnected. No data is collected through automated extraction (scraping).
legal.privacy_p4: The service relies on a hosting provider, a database and, when content is generated, an artificial intelligence provider. Only the data needed for each processing operation is passed to them.
legal.privacy_p5: Your data is kept as long as your account is active, then deleted within 30 days of your request.
legal.privacy_p6: You can access, correct, export or delete your data by writing to the publisher's contact address.
legal.terms_intro: By using PostPilot, you agree to the following terms.
legal.terms_p1: PostPilot helps write, prepare and publish content on social networks. Content generated by artificial intelligence must be reviewed before publishing.
legal.terms_p2: You remain responsible for the content published on your accounts and for complying with each social network's terms.
legal.terms_p3: The service is offered through monthly plans subject to quotas. The free trial lasts 14 days.
legal.terms_p4: You can stop using the service at any time and ask for your data to be deleted.
legal.deletion_intro: You can withdraw PostPilot's access to your accounts and request the deletion of your data at any time.
legal.deletion_p1: In "Social networks", the "Disconnect" button immediately deletes the access tokens of the account concerned.
legal.deletion_p2: In Facebook settings, under "Apps and websites", remove PostPilot. Meta notifies us and your connected accounts are deleted automatically.
legal.deletion_p3: To delete your entire account, write to the publisher's contact address. The request is processed within 30 days.
